dataset.name: freMTPL2freq
dataset.target: observed: the policy filed at least one claim

missing_field_check.description: dropping a required numeric field must block the recommendation

limitations: freMTPL2 carries no insurer accept/reject ground truth: the target is the real observed fact "the policy filed at least one claim". Quality is therefore a discrimination proxy of the final risk score against an observed outcome, not a measure of an acceptance policy.
The eleven agents are deterministic by default (no provider call): token and dollar totals are legitimately zero. The LLM document review is opt-in and, without a provider key, never runs.

The dynamic decision chain (risk -> decision, plus the optional uncertainty escalation) is what makes quality vary across combinations; the other optional agents feed the consolidated report but rarely alter the recommendation.
Missing-field robustness is a fail-closed property of the intake agent: it is identical across combinations and is therefore reported once, not per combination.
